Name: Brown Ceramic Pillars
Author: OfInstrumentals
Description:
I liked the shape of the Ceramic Pillar, but not the color of it. The blue was too cold and clinical, so I recolored the item in brown tones. There are six to choose from, possibly more if there's demand and I get around to it.

An Alternative Textures version of this mod can be found [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21583]here[/url].

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[b]Installing[/b]
Unzip the file and drop the (CP) Brown Ceramic Pillar-folder in to the Mods-folder.
If you've downloaded this mod previously, you may have a version with a folder that has a bunch of numbers in the name. I recommend deleting that old folder before moving the new one in to the Mods-folder.

[b]Choosing a recolor[/b]
Launch the game to generate a config-file and edit it. In the Pillar-field, write your preferred color from the six available ones: DarkBrown, LightBrown, DarkRed, LightRed, DarkGray or LightGray. The default is DarkBrown.
[b]OR[/b] use GenericModConfigMenu.
